name: Telegram Death Notifier
description: Sends a death screenshot to a Telegram channel

runs-title.name: Runs - level defaults
runs-title.description: Configure the current level and choose Start positions or Minimum run progress in the pause-menu Runs tab. Defaults are used only where no setting is saved.

run-progress-enabled.name: Default mode: minimum run progress
run-progress-enabled.description: Default for levels without a saved mode. Off selects Start positions. Choose the current level mode in the Runs tab; only the selected filter runs.

default-min.name: Default minimum end percent
default-min.description: Start positions mode: default endpoint threshold for rows not configured yet.

minimum-run-progress.name: Default minimum run progress (%)
minimum-run-progress.description: Default step for levels without their own threshold. Each collision ends a clean segment. Noclip can report multiple qualifying segments in one attempt. Zero adds no distance restriction.

bot-token.name: Bot token
bot-token.description: Always hidden. Clear removes the token after applying changes. Stored locally; masking is not encryption.

msg-run.name: Run message
msg-run.description: Startpos, practice or noclip segment. Placeholders: {player}, {start}, {end}, {level}

custom-nickname.name: Use custom nickname
custom-nickname.description: Use the nickname below instead of your GD username

show-decimals.name: Show decimals
show-decimals.description: Off: truncate both endpoints to whole percentages. On: round and display the chosen number of decimal places for calculations and messages.

decimal-places.name: Decimal places
decimal-places.description: Number of digits after the decimal point in percentages (1-4).

only-best.name: Only new bests
only-best.description: Start positions mode only: normal deaths from 0%. Does not restrict practice, checkpoint runs or minimum run progress.
